exits.label: Door
exits.text: I open the apartment door. The hall waits colder than it should.

verbs.look: The apartment door looks ordinary, which feels rude considering everything else.
verbs.pickup: I am not taking the front door. The hallway can keep its teeth.

use.text: I open the apartment door. The hall waits colder than it should.

onEnter.text: Apartment 708 still knows my shape. For now, the room is bright enough to lie.

#ff0000.label: Door
#ff0000.text: The door is heavy, but not locked. The hallway on the other side has been listening.

verbs.look: The door is heavy, but not locked. The hallway on the other side has been listening.
verbs.pickup: I am not taking the front door. The hallway can keep its teeth.

use.text: I open the apartment door. The hall waits colder than it should.

#00ff00.label: Desk
#00ff00.text: Old bills, half-written lyrics, and a note in my own handwriting: If I forget, check the books.

verbs.look: Old bills, half-written lyrics, and a note in my own handwriting: If I forget, check the books.
verbs.pickup: I am not taking the desk. The debt can stay attached to the furniture.
verbs.use: I search the desk again. The note keeps pointing at the books like past me got dramatic with breadcrumbs.

#ff8800.label: Flag
#ff8800.text: A Chilean flag, pinned up like proof somebody here still believed in places. I look at it longer than I mean to.

verbs.look: A Chilean flag, pinned up like proof somebody here still believed in places. I look at it longer than I mean to.
verbs.pickup: I leave it pinned. Some things are not loot.
verbs.use: I touch the edge of the flag. Cloth, memory, exile. Too much for an inventory slot.

#0000ff.label: Bed
#0000ff.text: The sheets smell like cold sweat and cheap detergent. Somebody slept badly here.

verbs.look: The sheets smell like cold sweat and cheap detergent. Somebody slept badly here.
verbs.pickup: I am not carrying bedding into the apocalypse. Even I have aesthetic limits.
verbs.use: No time to lie down. The room already knows I am tired.

#ffff00.label: Table
#ffff00.text: A battlefield of mugs, paper, and things nobody wanted to throw away.

verbs.look: A battlefield of mugs, paper, and things nobody wanted to throw away.
verbs.use: I move a mug. Under it: another reason to clean later, if later exists.

#ff00ff.label: Window
#ff00ff.text: Snow crawls down the glass. Outside has the decency to stay outside.

verbs.look: Snow crawls down the glass. Outside has the decency to stay outside.
verbs.pickup: I am not taking the window. I am trying to leave through better ideas.
verbs.use: The window sticks. Outside refuses the shortcut.

#00ffff.label: Television
#00ffff.text: Dead screen. Heavy glass. The kind of silence that used to mean late-night movies.

verbs.look: Dead screen. Heavy glass. The kind of silence that used to mean late-night movies.
verbs.pickup: The TV is too heavy and too dead. Bad combination.
verbs.use: I press a button. The television remains loyal to silence.

#380f04.label: Lamp
#380f04.text: The lamp keeps its small promise. Warmth, a little circle of it, and nothing more.

verbs.look: The lamp keeps its small promise. Warmth, a little circle of it, and nothing more.
verbs.pickup: No. The lamp is doing important emotional labor here.
verbs.use: I leave it on. Darkness already owns enough.

#808080.label: Punchingbag
#808080.text: Judging by the dents, somebody was training for the end of the world.

verbs.look: Judging by the dents, somebody was training for the end of the world.
verbs.pickup: I am not carrying a punching bag. I already have unresolved issues.
verbs.use: I give it one hit. It swings back like a bad memory.

#ffffff.label: Books
#ffffff.text: Between two swollen paperbacks, I find a small key taped to the inside cover.
#ffffff.repeatText: Apparently the chosen one only needed friendship, courage, and a legendary blade.

verbs.look: Swollen paperbacks, cracked spines, one suspicious gap. Past me was many things, but subtle was not one of them.

pickup.text: Between two swollen paperbacks, I find a small key taped to the inside cover.
pickup.repeatText: Apparently the chosen one only needed friendship, courage, and a legendary blade.

verbs.use: I check the books with my hands this time. The little key was waiting for me to stop just looking.

#955746.label: Jacket
#955746.text: It is my jacket, but after all of this, it feels like it belongs to someone I used to be.

verbs.look: It is my jacket, but after all of this, it feels like it belongs to someone I used to be.
verbs.pickup: I leave the jacket. Too much old skin in it.
verbs.use: I check the pockets. Nothing but lint and a tiny betrayal.

#042d0e.label: Picture
#042d0e.text: I remember hiding something before sleep became impossible.

verbs.look: I remember hiding something before sleep became impossible.
verbs.pickup: No. The picture stays. It is already carrying too much.
verbs.use: The memory points back toward the books.

#26863d.label: VHS
#26863d.text: The tape label reads: DO NOT LOSE THE SMALL ONE. I hate when past me is vague.

verbs.look: The tape label reads: DO NOT LOSE THE SMALL ONE. I hate when past me is vague.
verbs.pickup: No VCR, no time, no nostalgia tax.
verbs.use: The label keeps nagging me about the small one. Small key. Small chance. Same energy.

#161d47.label: Pictures
#161d47.text: Pictures from a cleaner life. I study them like evidence from a case I already lost.

verbs.look: Pictures from a cleaner life. I study them like evidence from a case I already lost.
verbs.pickup: I leave them. Proof is heavy.
verbs.use: I turn one picture over. Nothing hidden. Just the past being theatrical.

#2d3c9e.label: Heater
#2d3c9e.text: At least something in this place still remembers how to be warm.

verbs.look: At least something in this place still remembers how to be warm.
verbs.pickup: Stealing the heater would be funny for three seconds and fatal for my back.
verbs.use: I touch it. Warm enough to be suspicious.
